decision.explanation: The original sources present two distinct assertions regarding the formation date of the 24th Rifle Division. Document 1 (D1S3) states it was formed on July 26, 1918. Document 2 (D2S3) states it was formed on January 1, 1920. Both documents describe the same entity ('24th Rifle Division' or '24th Simbirsk Rifle Division') and the same event ('formed on the order of the Revolutionary Military Council'). Per the instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and not collapse multi-answer questions to a single winner when competing assertions exist, both years are retained as valid answers derived directly from the provided source text.
